programs.title: Anari
programs.desc: The film follows Raja and Poonam, a young couple whose romance is strained by extreme poverty, family responsibilities, and a tempting, immoral job offer, putting their love and moral compass to the test

programs.title: Guddi
programs.desc: Kusum is obsessed with Bollywood movies and is unable to distinguish between the real world and the movie world, to the extent that she refuses to marry anyone besides her idol, Dharmendra.

programs.title: Khote Sikkay
programs.desc: An unknown horseback rider is after Jhanga, an evil and troublesome gangster who has terrorised everybody in the village, because he is responsible for his father's death.

programs.title: Aitbaar
programs.desc: Trying to escape an abusive marriage with Jaideep, Neha returns to her ex-lover Sagar. However, when Jaideep claims that he is a changed man, Neha faces a dilemma about whom she wants to be with.
